definitions.explanation: A portable space heater that burns kerosene (灯油) for fuel. Widely used in Japanese homes, especially in rural areas and older buildings without central heating.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To turn on the kerosene heater.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: When winter comes, the kerosene heater gets a lot of use.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やかん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加湿|かしつ}→加湿：29748_kashitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I put a kettle on the kerosene heater to humidify the room.

notes: Common collocations: {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to turn on), {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to turn off), {石油|せきゆ}ストーブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to add kerosene). Many Japanese place a kettle on top for humidity. Requires regular refueling with ⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧ (kerosene), which is sold at gas stations and delivered by truck in residential areas. Also called ⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧. Distinguished from ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦ストーブ→ストーブ：02906_sutoobu⟧ (electric heater) and ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧ (air conditioning/heating).
